evidence_scope: Source-verified approved-change metadata trace: five CR reason-and-summary records under the original captured-field gate, DISTINCT CR and tdoc ASC LIMIT5. Original cover fields10 and actual approval roles5 are certified; full162 native rows preserve the selection population.
original_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(c:CR) WHERE c.reasonForChange IS NOT NULL WITH DISTINCT c ORDER BY c.tdocNumber LIMIT 5 RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, c.reasonForChange AS reason, c.summaryOfChange AS summary
question_en: Return the change reasons and summaries of CRs approved by agreements (approved-change review).
reference_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(c:CR) WHERE c.reasonForChange IS NOT NULL WITH DISTINCT c ORDER BY c.tdocNumber LIMIT 5 RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, c.reasonForChange AS reason, c.summaryOfChange AS summary

required_fields.name: tdocNumber
required_fields.role: CR record identity associating each requested change reason with its own summary

required_fields.name: reason
required_fields.role: The requested CR change-reason source metadata field, not an identity-only substitute

required_fields.name: summary
required_fields.role: The requested CR summary-of-change source metadata field
